what: A line with a thickness of 4.5% of the panel width (phone 6.4%) and round caps is drawn over the panel on a canvas. Each point turns along a small ellipse (40px tall·20px wide, phone 15·7.5px) at its position in panel ratio, with different phase and direction, so the whole line sways slowly (time × .4). The dash gap is set to the line length, and moving the gap offset from −1 to 0 draws the line in 3.6s power4.inOut, while 0 to 1 erases it from the front. When tied to scroll, it slowly morphs into the second shape (following .4 of the remainder each time). Past the end it is erased in 1.8s power4.out, and back at the top it is drawn again in 2.4s power4.out. ”pulse” is drawn in 2.4s power4.out and erased in 2s power4.inOut with a 1s overlap

options.pts: Point list (comma separated). A polyline is ‹x y phase direction›, and with curve: 1 it is ‹x y cx cy phase direction› (cx cy is the handle coming into that point, and the outgoing handle is mirrored and joined). x and y are board ratios, phase is in π units, direction is 1 or −1
options.pts-sp: Point list to use at 768px width or below (point count must match), otherwise pts
options.to · to-sp: Second shape the scroll morphs into (point count must match)
options.curve: If 1, Bezier curve, default is a polyline
options.width · width-sp: Line weight = Panel width × this value, default .045 · .064
options.amp · amp-sp: Wave vertical radius (px, horizontal is half), default 40 · 15 — 0 gives a flat line
options.min-width: Minimum canvas width on wide screens (px, centered on the panel, overflow cropped), default 0 — Brand 1000
options.color: Line color CSS variable name, default --kf-raised
options.on: load (draws right on attach, default) · enter (draws once it enters above the screen bottom margin%) · drawn (fully drawn from the start, rippling) · manual (waits for an event)
options.dur · delay · ease: Initial draw length · delay · curve, default 3.6 · 0 · power4.inOut
options.margin: Bottom screen margin for on: enter (%), default 10
options.scrub: Binds the to shape to this selector’s scroll range (scrub, remaining share .4 each)
options.start · end: scrub range, default top top-=1px · bottom 20%
options.leave: With erase, it erases when passing the end of the scrub (erase-dur default 1.8) and draws again when it returns above the start point (back-dur default 2.4)
options.fx:draw · fx:erase · fx:pulse · fx:fade: Events fired on an element — draw (detail dur, ease, delay, from), erase, draw and erase once, fade and stop in .4s, 0 to 1 toward the second shape (detail value), and pause drawing (detail false resumes). The same can be called as a function through el.kfWiggleLine

note: The element is positioned by whoever uses it (absolute · fixed). The canvas is laid inside the element and does not block clicks. It does not draw when off-screen or during hold. Colors are read from css variables so they follow when the skin is swapped

from.where: index.html .sd-kv__line (hero mountain-shaped line — drawn over 3.6s, second shape on scroll, erased at the end) · .sd-tech__line (a different type for each of six sections, pulse on every slide change · fade on leaving) · footer .sd-foot__line (fully drawn, undulating)
